all.body: Only the parties to this contract may enforce its terms. No one else has any right to enforce any of them under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999.

sc.body: Only the parties to this contract may enforce its terms. Nothing in it creates a third-party right under the Contract (Third Party Rights) (Scotland) Act 2017.

all.body: This contract is governed by the law of England and Wales. The courts and tribunals of England and Wales deal with any dispute about it.
This contract is governed by the law of Scotland. The Scottish courts and tribunals deal with any dispute about it.
This contract is governed by the law of Northern Ireland. The courts and tribunals of Northern Ireland, including the industrial tribunals, deal with any dispute about it.
